rationale: The production roadmap requires backup and disaster recovery evidence before AEIS can be production-ready. This change introduces operational backup/restore primitives, manifest checksums, RTO/RPO policy validation and an automated local restore drill. It is D4 because backup/DR is an architecture-level operational control.

steps: Remove the production roadmap freeze document for backup/DR primitives.
Run the existing startup/security test group to confirm no unrelated behavior changed.

fidelity_test.description: Verify that a SQLite backup writes a manifest with checksum, can be restored, passes integrity_check and preserves table row counts.
pre_conditions: Temporary SQLite databases are created inside pytest tmp_path.
steps: Assert backup manifest contains SHA256 and retention policy.
Assert restored SQLite database preserves rows and integrity_check=ok.
Assert BackupPolicy enforces backup interval <= 360 minutes, RPO <= 60 minutes, RTO <= 30 minutes and WAL/archive when backup interval exceeds RPO.
fidelity_test.expected_outcome: The local backup/restore drill is repeatable and policy validation catches invalid production backup shapes.
